correctness.rationale: For the sole new noncyclic case, the 56 reduced order-five squares are exhaustively enumerated, the 50-square noncyclic isotopy orbit is separated from the 6-square cyclic orbit, and every one of its 507 nonempty faces and 1,406 incidences is checked. A globally acyclic Forman matching leaves four critical edges and 52 critical triangles over a vertex. Its signed integral Morse boundary has a determinant -1 full row-rank 4x4 minor, giving reduced H2=Z^48 and no other reduced homology. A separate exact elimination of all 126 edge-path generators using Tietze moves establishes π1=1, completing the S2 wedge proof by Hurewicz and Whitehead. verify.py replays all checks. The cyclic output is reference only and not an accepted new claim.

originality.rationale: The new claim is strictly the noncyclic order-five Latin-square 48-two-sphere classification. A previously recorded Paley-25 clique-complex result giving 64 two-spheres covers the cyclic class because its Latin-square cell-conflict graph is isomorphic to the self-complementary Paley graph; the cyclic case is explicitly excluded as novelty. A direct exact graph-isomorphism test showed the noncyclic cell-conflict graph is not Paley nor its complement, so that prior result does not cover the new claim. The exact-object Latin-square isotopy census and full-text rainbow-matching literature do not entail the noncyclic homotopy type. Indexed colorful-assignment results concern non-equivalent complexes; the residual risk is an undiscovered equivalent result about the noncyclic graph.
residual_risks: Search and indexed metadata do not establish global novelty; an unindexed exact simplicial-complex calculation could exist.
Not all historical Latin-transversal papers were available in full text, including the otherwise relevant transversal-count paper (bibliographic/abstract-only access).
The modern survey was not comprehensively inspected page by page, and any potential topology mention beyond reviewed material remains uncertain.
The classification is a reproducible finite theorem with no independent mathematical audit or independent formal proof beyond the included verifier.
The noncyclic graph may have another standard name whose homotopy type is known but not returned by synonym searches; this would invalidate originality if covering.

value.rationale: The first two-isotopy-class odd order is a canonical complete small-order classification problem. The new 48-two-sphere integral homotopy theorem covers precisely the noncyclic order-five class; the cyclic class was already covered by a Paley-25 clique-complex calculation and is not claimed new. It distinguishes the two natural classes topologically by different H2 ranks, completing the small-order classification and supplying a meaningful exact invariant without an arbitrary restricted family or any claim of a general result for all orders.
